source_corpus.corpus_limitation_statement: Audit is strictly bounded to physically available local documents. The absence of specific metrics or scale definitions reflects authentic source reality and is not extrapolated to uninspected external or historical corporate records.

evidence_classification_rules.SOURCE_REQUIREMENT: Explicit functional or architectural requirement literally mandated by source documents.
evidence_classification_rules.SOURCE_METRIC_WITHOUT_TARGET: Metric family explicitly named for monitoring/telemetry in source documents, but without any associated numeric threshold.
evidence_classification_rules.SOURCE_NUMERIC_TARGET: Contractual quantitative target literally mandated by authoritative source documents.
evidence_classification_rules.APPROVED_ARCHITECTURE_CONSTRAINT: Architectural invariant, design boundary, or governance rule approved in Phase-0 ADRs or guardrails.
evidence_classification_rules.PHASE_0_ENGINEERING_PROPOSAL: Quantitative target or operational number proposed by engineering in technical specifications to validate during PoC/benchmarking rather than an original contractual source target.
evidence_classification_rules.REQUIRES_BUSINESS_CONFIRMATION: Parameter, baseline, or policy requiring explicit business, customer, platform, or legal confirmation.
evidence_classification_rules.NOT_FOUND_IN_AVAILABLE_SOURCES: Concept or metric completely unmentioned in accessible project source documents.

operational.data_category: canonical_operational_records (goals, plans, tasks, workflows, schedules, assignments)
operational.deletion_archive_defined: Approved/canonical scheduling results and required scheduling evidence are persisted in E-7 PostgreSQL according to the canonical scheduling data model (docs/data-model/CANONICAL_OWNERSHIP_AND_SERVICE_BOUNDARIES.md). Tenant-configurable retention/export/delete policy (Spec Sec. 23, p. 17; Plan Sec. 16, p. 16).
History retention level configurable in workflow runtime; cleanup policy unstated in sources.

Approved/canonical scheduling results and required scheduling evidence are persisted in E-7 PostgreSQL according to the canonical scheduling data model. Specific retention or deletion period is unresolved in available sources.

audit_events.governance_rule: Audit logs must be append-only at application level and immutable while retained (Spec Sec. 23). Immutability while retained does NOT mean retain forever (append-only != retain forever). Parameterized via AUDIT_RETENTION_DAYS (Plan Sec. 17.2) as a configuration placeholder, but sources do not establish an approved default duration. AUDIT_RETENTION_DURATION = UNRESOLVED, AUDIT_RETENTION_POLICY = TENANT / CUSTOMER / LEGAL POLICY DRIVEN.

PostgreSQL transactional outbox provides durable event publication and event publication state must survive broker outages (ADR-005, Spec Sec. 21, Plan Sec. 15). Published/unpublished semantics exist where frozen architecture defines them. Available sources do not establish an outbox pruning rule, archival policy, or retention duration. Durability does not imply indefinite retention. OUTBOX_RETENTION_DURATION = UNRESOLVED, OUTBOX_PRUNING_POLICY = NOT_DEFINED_IN_AVAILABLE_SOURCES.

Consumer deduplication and inbox idempotency are required by architecture invariants (Spec Sec. 21, ADR-005, Plan Sec. 15). However, available sources do not define a specific replay window duration or inbox retention lifecycle. Idempotency requirements do not themselves define a retention period. INBOX_DEDUP_RETENTION_DURATION = UNRESOLVED, REPLAY_WINDOW_DURATION = UNRESOLVED.

ai_temporary.governance_rule: AI recommendations carry rationale and confidence metadata. Prompts receive minimum necessary context (ADR-002, Spec Sec. 23); persistent retention of full raw prompt transcripts is unstated in source documents.

Solver-internal temporary/search artifacts are not established as canonical E-7 records by available sources. Approved/canonical scheduling results and required scheduling evidence are persisted in E-7 PostgreSQL according to the canonical scheduling data model (ADR-003, ADR-006, docs/data-model/CANONICAL_OWNERSHIP_AND_SERVICE_BOUNDARIES.md). Canonical scheduling state belongs to E-7 PostgreSQL; solver-internal temporary/search state has no source-defined retention lifecycle. Available sources do not imply that internal solver search artifacts are persisted, nor that they are deleted automatically. SOLVER_TEMPORARY_RETENTION_DURATION = UNRESOLVED, SOLVER_TEMPORARY_DATA_LIFECYCLE = NOT_DEFINED_IN_AVAILABLE_SOURCES.

telemetry.governance_rule: Logs are structured JSON with tenant-safe fields; zero secrets or raw sensitive model context logged (Plan Sec. 16, p. 17). Centralized telemetry retention duration is unstated in available application sources.

personal_sensitive.source_authority: Trusted MySQL Adapter / Task Intelligence Context Builder
personal_sensitive.governance_rule: Individual `students` / `student_session` source rows are prohibited from the Task Intelligence planner/model context under the frozen aggregate-only access policy (docs/integrations/MYSQL_TASK_INTELLIGENCE_DATA_MAPPING.md, docs/integrations/AI_CONTEXT_ACCESS_POLICY.md, docs/adr/ADR-002-task-intelligence-orchestration.md). Adapter-derived aggregate cohort values are permitted. This evidence audit does not infer a system-wide retention rule beyond that approved boundary.
Staff names used as sanitized display labels or opaque references. Retained in accordance with tenant employment master data agreements.

identity_users.source_evidence: Source documents establish tenant isolation and principal derivation but specify zero active or concurrent user numbers.

task_intelligence.source_evidence: Reference exam scenario breaks down into 9 work categories and ~10-30 tasks for test gold sets. Production goal/task volume is unstated.

workflow.source_evidence: Flowable BPMN execution verified for single workflow scenario cases (happy path, reject, SLA breach). Production process instance volume is unstated.

scheduling.source_evidence: Test fixtures exercise 2 cohorts, 5 exams, 10 sessions. Production timetable/exam problem scale (number of rooms, faculty, slots) is unstated.

resources.source_evidence: Test catalog RS-SYNTH-001 contains 14 resources. Production institutional resource scale is unstated.

integrations.source_evidence: Upstream MySQL schema inventory catalogues 247 tables, 2,637 columns, and 307 foreign keys. This defines SCHEMA COMPLEXITY ONLY, not production database row volume or integration traffic.

events.source_evidence: Four canonical event types verified from source event model. Daily message publication rate is unstated.

storage.source_evidence: PostgreSQL database storage growth and document attachment storage requirements are unstated in sources.

ai_inference.source_evidence: Daily AI request volume, concurrent inference calls, and token consumption budgets are unstated in sources.

concurrency.source_evidence: Horizontal scalability of API workers and queue isolation of solver jobs are mandated architecture rules, but peak concurrent requests/sec are unstated.

decision_gaps.description: Confirmation of whether proposed p95 < 500 ms target for CRUD APIs and asynchronous execution for LLM/solver jobs should become the formal candidate SLO.
Confirmation of target monthly uptime tier (e.g., 99.9% proposed) for production pilot.
Definition of representative first-tenant parameters: active users, faculty headcount, student cohort size, and peak concurrent users.
Definition of expected operational volume: daily goals, active workflows, and scheduling problem dimensions (courses, exams, room count).
Specification of acceptable solve duration ceiling (SOLVER_MAX_SECONDS), LLM response timeout (LLM_TIMEOUT), and token cost limits.
Specification of retention periods for operational history, completed workflow instances, audit ledgers (AUDIT_RETENTION_DAYS), and telemetry logs.
Determination of whether formal Recovery Time Objective (RTO) and Recovery Point Objective (RPO) are required for pilot rollout and definition of target intervals.

inputs_required_for_0h2: Task 0H.2 may formulate candidate engineering baselines once the missing business/platform/compliance inputs are explicitly documented. Task 0H.1 itself does not select them.
Business and platform input on desired API responsiveness and confirmation of proposed CRUD p95 < 500 ms target
Business and platform input on required uptime/availability tier (evaluating proposed 99.9% monthly validation status)
Business input on pilot institutional user count and peak concurrent user envelope
Business input on expected daily operations volume (goals created, workflows launched, schedules published)
Business input on expected scheduling problem size (courses, sections, rooms, examination horizon)
Platform input on AI token cost tolerance and solver solve budget (SOLVER_MAX_SECONDS)
Compliance input on retention policy by data class (operational records, audit trails, telemetry)
Platform input on disaster recovery objectives (RTO / RPO definitions if mandatory for pilot)
